mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with fluphenazine (dopamine antagonist with some serotonergic activity) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS depression.
action: Use combination cautiously with patient monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); consider alternative antipsychotic with lower serotonergic activity if possible.
